mapper.sql: id, job_id, status, format, storage_key, sha256, size_bytes, requested_by, started_at, finished_at, retention_days, expires_at, error_summary, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO admin_job (job_type, target_type, target_id, requested_by, request_payload) VALUES ('DATABASE_BACKUP', 'DATABASE_BACKUP', NULL, #{actorId}, '{}'::jsonb) RETURNING id
INSERT INTO database_backup (job_id, requested_by, retention_days) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{actorId}, #{retentionDays}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_job SET target_id = #{backupId}, request_payload = jsonb_build_object('backupId', #{backupId}), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: UPDATE database_backup backup SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', storage_key = #{storageKey}, sha256 = #{sha256}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, finished_at = now(), expires_at = now() + make_interval(days => retention_days), error_summary = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE backup.id = #{backupId} AND backup.job_id = #{jobId} AND backup.status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_job job WHERE job.id = #{jobId} AND job.status = 'RUNNING' AND job.attempt = #{attempt} AND job.lease_token = CAST(#{leaseToken,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) ) RETURNING backup.id
UPDATE database_backup SET status = 'VALIDATED', error_summary = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{backupId} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'VALIDATED') AND storage_key IS NOT NULL RETURNING

UPDATE database_backup SET status = 'FAILED', error_summary = 'Backup validation failed', expires_at = COALESCE(expires_at, now() + make_interval(days => retention_days)), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{backupId} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'VALIDATED') RETURNING
SELECT FROM database_backup WHERE id = #{backupId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT status FROM admin_job WHERE id = #{jobId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE database_backup backup SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = COALESCE(backup.finished_at, now()), expires_at = COALESCE( backup.expires_at, now() + make_interval(days => backup.retention_days)), error_summary = 'Backup job did not complete', updated_at = now() FROM admin_job job WHERE backup.job_id = job.id AND backup.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND job.status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS', 'CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM database_backup WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now() AND status NOT IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY expires_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE database_backup SET status = 'DELETE_FAILED', error_summary = #{summary}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{backupId} AND status NOT IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
